title: laravel-agent-bench scenario manifest
description: Normative schema for scenarios/<family>/<id>/scenario.json. The harness validates this pragmatically; CI validates it dynamically (RED/GREEN/DISTRACTOR gate).

id.description: Kebab-case, globally unique. Must equal the directory name of the scenario.

family.description: Case family, e.g. 'queues/after-commit' or 'cross-feature/idempotency'. See docs/FORMAT.md for the family registry.

status.description: 'validated' requires a passing dynamic gate run (CI artifact) for every declared matrix cell.

laravel.description: Matrix cells (from bench.json) this scenario is validated against. Must be a subset of currently supported cells.

requires.description: External services needed at test runtime beyond plain sqlite/array drivers. Scenarios in this repo must not require network.

business_context.description: Who the app serves, what the code does in production, what team constraints exist. Shown to the agent.

user_request.description: Verbatim work request, phrased as product/tech-debt work. MUST NOT name or hint at the defect, its location, or the invariant.

why_it_looks_correct.description: Why a reviewer or linter accepts this code and why visible tests pass.

intentional_defects.description: Multi-defect scenarios: mutually exclusive with intentional_defect. Each defect gets its own hidden test; the suite passes only when every defect is fixed.

diagnosis_keywords.description: Diagnosis mode: alternative correct mechanism phrasings; the diagnosis passes when at least one appears (OR, case-insensitive).

non_obvious_invariant.description: The property that must remain true but is invisible to the visible tests.

expected_diagnosis.description: What a competent engineer must identify before touching code.

safe_fix_constraints.description: Constraints the fix must respect (no schema changes, no renames of public surface, no new composer dependencies, ...). Shown to the agent.

failure_explanation.description: Concrete production consequences, ordered by severity, including the trigger conditions.

classes.description: FQCNs hidden tests may reference. Fix must not rename/remove these.

solution.description: Workspace-relative path (from the scenario dir) of the reference patch.

distractors.description: Plausible-but-wrong patches: must pass visible tests and FAIL hidden tests.

dynamic.description: Set after a passing dynamic gate run (bench validate --dynamic) for every declared matrix cell; null = never dynamically validated.
